verdict.rationale: Honcho documents a first-party CLI at honcho.dev/cli with commands for local startup (`honcho start`), peer reasoning queries (`honcho peer chat`) and health checks (`honcho doctor`). It is AI-native: commands emit JSON when stdout isn't a TTY or `--json` is set, errors are structured with stable error codes, and it shares the config file used by SDKs and plugins. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, documented installation/distribution details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: honcho start runs API, deriver, Postgres, and Redis via Docker.
honcho peer chat returns answers grounded in a peer's full representation
honcho doctor verify connection and workspace health
Every command emits JSON when stdout isn't a TTY or when --json is forced. Structured errors with stable error codes.
Reads and writes ~/.honcho/config.json — the same file plugins, host integrations, and SDKs use.
